name: Crazy Shop
description: Importer and online retailer in Montevideo covering fitness, camping, bicycles, wellness, electric mobility, home and garden products. States shipping to Montevideo and the interior; costs, times and pickup terms are not stated on the homepage.
description_es: Importadora y comercio online con sede en Montevideo que cubre fitness, camping, bicicletas, bienestar, movilidad eléctrica, hogar y jardín. Indica envíos a Montevideo y al interior; los costos, plazos y condiciones de retiro no figuran en la página principal.

ships_to.notes: Homepage states shipping to all of Uruguay, Montevideo and interior. Costs and times not stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Lists a Montevideo address; in-store pickup is not stated.

sources.supports: nationwide shipping, categories and store address
